# Fantail Weddings

Boutique wedding planning for intimate weddings of 20 to 60 guests across the South Island of Aotearoa New Zealand, mostly for couples planning from overseas. Founded and run by Rebecca Brosnahan, who has 16+ years in the wedding industry and personally plans every wedding. She takes on a small number of weddings each year, by choice. Winner, LUXlife Magazine Global Wedding Awards 2026 (Luxury Destination Wedding Planning Specialists of the Year, New Zealand).

## Services
- Intimate Weddings: full planning for 20 to 60 guests, from the first enquiry to the end of the celebration, including venue scouting (with access to private South Island land not found online), vendor selection, multi-day weekend design, guest experience and weather planning. Planning from NZD $8,800 + GST. Most couples invest NZD $65,000 to $230,000 in total across vendors and the celebration. Vendors are paid directly by the couple; Rebecca takes no commissions.
- On-the-Day Coordination: for couples who have planned their own wedding. Around 30 hours of Rebecca's time: 10 hours before the day (onboarding, vendor confirmation, detail checks and the rehearsal), 15 hours on the day, and 5 hours for packdown and returns. From NZD $3,600 + GST. Requires a finalised wedding-day timeline; if the couple doesn't have one, Rebecca builds it with them for NZD $560 + GST. Travel and extra events (such as a welcome dinner) are quoted separately; her second-in-command, Meghan, can join at NZD $75 + GST an hour when needed.

Fantail Weddings no longer offers elopement planning or online consultations.

## Where Rebecca works
Wānaka, Queenstown and the wider Central Otago region most often, plus the Mackenzie Country (including Aoraki/Mt Cook), Banks Peninsula and Akaroa, the Marlborough Sounds, and occasionally Fiordland. Based in Christchurch.

## Good to know
- Overseas couples can legally marry in New Zealand. A marriage licence is required: apply at least 3 working days before the wedding; it is valid for 3 months. Current fees: https://www.govt.nz/browse/family-and-whanau/getting-married/get-a-marriage-licence
- Most couples get in touch 12 to 18 months ahead. Peak season (late February to April) often books around 18 months out.
